bio: It has to be said that a spectacular location such as Boutique Hotel Blaue Burg is something of a rarity in Germany. Nestled amid the peaks of the Allgäu Alps, the premises can only be accessed via a private road – the view is breathtaking! The small restaurant is where Simon Schlachter wins diners over with a modern and creative dining concept, which aims to offer a shared experience. He achieves this with a set menu whose courses each consist of several small dishes and are perfect for sharing. Up to 18 dishes full of different components and flavours – this reflects his own elaborate style and creates a sense of complexity. To complete the picture, there is the upscale decor and professional service courtesy of the charming maître d', who happens to be the chef's partner. Alternatively,...
